title_ru: JANUS OMNI-VERSE — одна причинная реальность, разные линзы восприятия

sources.role: detailed design note using arrow notation and unquoted values

source_supported_design.invariant: the same underlying entity or event is presented differently while its causal identity and state remain shared
source_supported_design.ai_instruction: adapt presentation to the player's style and generate the world dynamically

normalized_architecture.consistency_rule: A lens may transform presentation but must not independently alter canonical state.

why_admitted: It isolates perspective from causality: different interpretations share one underlying state.
It connects JANUS duality to an implementable game-design boundary.
It is a distinct concept from merely applying two visual skins because consequences are intended to remain common.
boundaries_and_risks: The source is a design proposal, not proof that a scalable one-world backend exists.
The detailed source is not valid JSON and cannot be treated as a machine-readable configuration without normalization.
References to existing games are comparative examples, not licensed content or ownership claims.
Universal economy and permadeath require anti-abuse, recovery, accessibility, moderation, and consent rules.
Dynamic generation must not silently change canonical rules between players.
The phrase 'all games of humanity' is aspirational and not admitted as a delivered capability.

recommended_route.game_repository: formal event schema, deterministic adapters, economy invariants, moderation rules, and replay tests
